remarks: Welcome to Greenwich Hills - this sunny and spacious 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath unit offers comfortable living with great community amenities. The fully equipped kitchen opens to a dining area with sliders leading to a peaceful private patio, perfect for enjoying the outdoors. A spacious living room completes the main level. Upstairs, the primary suite features a private full bath, along with two additional bedrooms and a marble hall bath with whirlpool tub. The finished lower level offers a large family room plus a spacious laundry area, providing flexible living space. Offered furnished - with furniture shown in the listing included - or unfurnished. Two unassigned parking spaces are included, along with access to the community pool and tennis courts. The unit was freshly painted for its next tenant. No smoking and no pets permitted. Tenant must have excellent credit and comply with Greenwich Hills association rules and regulations.
